verdict.rationale: The docs touch on the trust model only in fragments. Skills may bundle optional scripts (docs-13, docs-7). Public plugins go through a review process with automated findings before publication (docs-31, docs-54, docs-55). Skills are split into curated and experimental tiers (docs-42). Sign in with ChatGPT shares only name, email and profile picture, and does not grant data access or auto-approve actions (docs-19). Missing for 10: a documented execution and permission model for what skill scripts can run, an explicit trust or sandbox policy for third-party skills and plugins, telemetry or data-collection disclosure, and independent corroboration.
